title: Concept: Secret in a framework or file context (java) — review required
description: In java, jdbc:[^"'s]*[?;&]password=[^"'s]+ places a secret where the framework or file format expects it. Context does not protect the value: it still lands in history, images, and dumps. The remedy is external storage via a secret store plus rotation.
applicability: java framework settings, connection strings, and config files; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential exposure through checkouts and artifacts; HIGH severity when the value is live.
